subject: SIG questionnaire: v2 versioning oddities & proposed rollback plan
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme.com>
To: security@redwood.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG v2: recent version diffs and re-answers?

Hi team,

We received SIG v2 from your side this morning and noticed a number of re-answers compared to the v1 we reviewed last quarter (particularly in encryption, key rotation, and retention). Can you: 1) provide a succinct diff (answers changed + rationale), 2) confirm which items have new evidence, and 3) tell us whether you support a rollback to prior answers if a compliance reviewer flags a regression?

Acme is on a tight audit window (target: audit readout the week of 6/14). If possible, we need a plan and artifacts by COB 6/7.

Thanks,
Lisa Chen
Principal, Acme Security
Acme Networks

Attachments: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, security@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG v2: recent version diffs and re-answers?

Hi Lisa — thanks for the heads up and the deadline.

Short answer: yes — we can provide a change log + evidence and we have a rollback path for a limited set of answers.

Proposed plan:
- Today (6/1): internal triage to enumerate changed questions and owners (CCing Mina and Rishi).
- By 6/4: deliver a consolidated diff PDF + a JSON of re-answers for programmatic import.
- By 6/7 COB: attach supporting evidence bundle for the changed answers.
- If audit flags regression: we will perform a controlled rollback for the affected answers and notify you within 24 hours; rollback will keep runtime configuration and only affect the SIG published answers.

Mina / Rishi — do you see any blockers to that schedule? I will assemble the diff and a short explanatory memo for Acme.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

- redwood-sig-answers-v2.json (machine diff of QIDs -> answers)
- SIG_v2_changes_list.csv (human readable)

Planned attachments for 6/7:
- evidence_rollup_v2.zip (PDFs, screenshots, role-change logs)

Blockers: product sign-off ETA 6/6 afternoon; if delayed, we'll note those items as "pending evidence" in the bundle.

-Mina

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Agree with the plan. A couple of operational notes:
- Rollback process: we can revert the published SIG answers in our control plane repo and re-publish prior answers; this is a non-disruptive metadata-only change. We should run rollback in staging first and snapshot the published JSON. Estimated time-to-rollback: ~2 hours with QA.
- Risk: if the re-answers were relied upon by downstream partners (we'll check route metadata) we should flag clients in the 72-hour window before rollback. Suggest we prepare a short communication template in advance.
- I added a Drive folder with current artifacts and a checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-sig-v2
- Also linking HubSpot deal where Acme requested the SOC/SIG materials: HubSpot: deal_83642

I'll pick up the snapshot/export and staging run.

-Rishi

Hi Lisa — attaching the artifacts per our timeline. Summary below.

What we provided (attachments):
- redwood-sig-answers-v2.json: machine-readable delta of question IDs -> previous answer / current answer / rationale.
- SIG_v2_diff_summary.pdf: one-page summary of the 6 substantive changes and why we adjusted answers (security improvements, clarifications of retention windows, consolidation of vendor access policy).
- evidence_rollup_v2.zip: supporting evidence for 11/14 items (PDFs, screenshots, rotation logs). Items pending product sign-off are tagged in the JSON and the PDF.

Rollback & timelines:
- If an auditor requests rollback for any re-answer, Redwood will: perform a staged rollback in staging (2h), notify flagged customers within 72h, then execute production rollback and publish updated SIG answers. We can commit to executing rollback within 48h after approval from Acme leads (to align with your audit cadence).

Next steps: please confirm if Acme can review the bundle by 6/10 COB. If you want, we can set a 30-min sync on 6/9 to walk through the changes.

Thanks and let us know the preferred POC for encryption questions (Mina is primary).

Best,
Hannah
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
